policy.policy: Common body heights; natural width from pre-v1 aspect, capped slender. Exact template cohort fits; width-only contact relaxations; compact-height contact exceptions are explicitly reported; normal body height remains common.

contact_guard_scope: Complete distinct source paths, constant Regular30 pen, positive gaps and half-unit margin; existing source contacts retained; same-path self-overlap and heavier weights outside this guard. Actual final coordinates quantized to6decimal places before checks. Height relaxation is limited to contact-unsafe compact profiles and explicitly reported.
reference_scope: User-supplied screenshot plus257 measurable public raster character dimensions inform width/height profiles; no proprietary outline or font copied. Raster metrics have approximately1pixel uncertainty.

visual_review.scope: Independent source-SVG ink review at fixed Regular30. Source renderings compare published v1 with current candidate, and include common literature forms, first16 codepoints, previous user royal strip, all21 former contact-limited cases, wide primitives, known reference compact roots and enclosures, five shared-component positions, final guard deltas, and ten stratified width relaxations. Byte-identical source drawings reuse their already viewed visual proofs. Final width relaxations are individually viewed at the sample level.

closed_counter_evidence.scope: Explicitly closed paths only. Excludes invalid/nonsimple centerline rings, loops formed by open paths or multiple paths, same-path open self-overlaps, and every other weight. Positive remaining area checks counter survival, not a guarantee of acceptable raster legibility.
